title: 第77章 柳家危机
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚全文完结版
content_zh: 柳家是落魄了，但柳家是书香门第，也曾是京都的名门望族。而柳老夫人，现在就是柳家的脊梁，让柳老夫人去跪着求人，京都百姓能把柳家众人的脊梁骨给戳断了。就算能暂时保住柳家，柳家也不过是以另外一种方式苟延残喘罢了！姜氏自然也很清楚这些，但那又如何？她才不想跟着柳家一起吃苦。她刚从姜家回来，父亲可是说了，柳公瑾是所有人公选出来的替罪羊，天王老子都救不了。皇帝如果查不了真相，最大的可能就是让柳公瑾背下这一切，从而保住柳家。所以柳家花再多的钱，也救不了柳公瑾，既然如此何不如让老太太自己去蹦跶一下，从而保住柳家家业，瓜分柳家家业才是正事。这也是她销毁唐逸书信的原因。只是姜氏的话引起了柳家大多数人的反感，大嫂沈氏当场站了起来，怒斥道：“你胡说什么？柳家人是都死光了吗？需要娘去跪着求人？”“娘要真跪了，柳家就彻底没救了。”姜氏最不满的就是沈氏的大义凛然，人不为己天诛地灭，她凭什么站在制高点指责自己？“大嫂，你这话就不对了，柳家都现在这样了，还装什么清高？”“柳公知都能低声下气求人，娘怎么就不能了？”姜氏没有理会柳家众人愤怒的眼神，剔着指甲淡淡道：“再说，现在只有娘亲自出马，大哥和彦哥儿才有一线生机，否则大哥和彦哥儿必死无疑。”柳文彦的事现在都还瞒着老夫人，现在被姜氏这么平淡揭穿，柳公知当场变脸：“姜末，你给我闭嘴！”“柳公知，你个废物，你敢凶我？”柳公知性格素来软弱，二房都是姜氏说了算。见到柳公知竟然敢骂自己，姜氏当场怒怼回去。只是触及柳老夫人冰冷的目光，她的怒火当场就灭了，连忙摆了摆手佯装笑了起来：“哎呀，娘，儿媳胡说的，你放心，大哥不会死，彦哥儿也不会死。”老夫人没有理会姜氏，淡漠看向沈氏：“彦哥儿怎么了？”沈氏见瞒不下去，只得实话实说：“炎儿的确和平远伯世子出去了，说是有个人能救相公，只是他们当晚去了青楼，不知为何被锦衣卫给带走了。”“还有小逸，逸儿也被带走了。”柳家只知道柳文彦和唐逸当晚被锦衣卫带走了，他们打听了一圈，说是因为得罪了户部尚书的公子刘州。沈氏自然是不相信的，锦衣卫直属皇帝，就算刘州的父亲是户部尚书，也不可能惊动锦衣卫亲自出手。当晚肯定还发生了其他事情。沈氏不知道的是，锦衣卫带走梁绍和柳文彦他们，完全是梁绍惹的祸，炎文帝当场将他下狱就是想给他一个教训。朕看上的人，你也敢给朕指手画脚？老夫人听到唐逸也参与了其中，惊得站了起来：“什么？小逸也牵涉其中了，他们怎么被锦衣卫带走了？有没有去问过唐家那边怎么回事？”沈氏脸色阴沉，道：“去问过了，颜霜玉在唐家门前竖起柳家人和狗严禁入内的牌子。”唐逸和柳文彦被抓去锦衣卫的当晚，她就亲自过去想要问唐敬怎么回事，结果门房通报后带出来的却是一块牌子要进也行，得跪着进去。颜霜玉明显是在报私仇！听完沈氏的话，老夫人面色铁青，冷声道：“派人给我盯紧唐家，确定唐敬回府，我亲自过去问问他怎么回事，我倒要看看……他敢不敢让我跪着进唐家！”沈氏想要说什么，但话到嘴边忍住了，老太太决定要做的事，谁都劝不住。柳公知狠狠瞪了一眼姜氏，姜氏想要做什么，他太清楚了。但是，他却拿姜氏没有半点办法。……唐逸没有跟着一处回北镇抚司，出了侍郎府后，萧棣为了杜绝唐逸迫害自己妹妹的可能性，不顾萧澜的反对，亲自将萧澜和孔诗岚送回了公主府。时间还早，唐逸没有回唐府，而是直接去了将军府。狄苍年迈，虽然还有报国之心，但炎文帝并没有让他率军北援，怕他这把老骨头死在北境。而经过几日的赶工，将军府的校场上已经屹立起了一座唐逸需要的训练场，接下来除了必要的上班，他还需要往返将军府训练，将身体底子锻炼起来。否则，就算前世他是杀神，现在在这个世界的武功面前，他也不过是蝼蚁而已。“小子，这就是你说的训练场？老夫和秦国公、鲁国公研究了两日，也没搞清楚这怎么玩。”狄苍抱着手看着唐逸，眼中有凶光。唐逸下意识地和狄苍拉开距离，显然陛下不准他领兵北援，这个糟老头心情很不爽，整个人就像是个火药桶。一点就炸，他可不想挨揍！狄苍见到唐逸想躲，一把将他拎了回来：“躲什么？赶紧说说怎么回事。”他这几日只能找几个老友，一起推演北境战场。只是推演了几日，谈到北狄大军的战力，三人都没有什么太好的破敌之策。谁都说服不了谁，那就只能研究唐逸让建造的训练基地了。结果看了两天，他们还是没有搞清楚唐逸这训练场怎么玩。“老爷子，的确就是我说的训练场，你老先别掐，我教你们怎么玩。”唐逸龇牙咧嘴，只觉得肩膀都要被掐碎了。狄苍轻哼一声松开他，他当即就卸掉了佩刀，向着训练场跑去。不得不说狄苍的工兵很厉害，几乎将他的图纸完美还原出来了。和前世特种兵的训练基地，几乎没有太大的出入。“什么意思？这小子是想用这训练场，将他这瘦猴一样的身体给练起来？开什么玩笑？”秦国公秦牧看着唐逸单薄的身体笑了起来，这家伙是缺练吗？这是缺吃啊！“老狄，你花这么多的时间去研究这个训练场……咳，说不定，它真的就是这孩子捣鼓出来的玩具场呢！”鲁国公程茂抱着双手，看到唐逸已经在训练场中跑了起来，不由笑着摇了摇头。他们都是大炎军界的传奇人物，不好好的研究北境之战，反倒在研究唐逸随便捣鼓的训练场，传出去不让人笑话吗？“等等看，这小子没有那么简单的。”狄苍双手叉腰摇了摇头，难道自己想错了，这不是什么练兵的方法？不应该啊！从那小子当日在状元楼的表现来看，应该是个懂兵法的，“北放北狄，东打东虞”之计，想法是何等大胆？但陛下却欣然接受了。这一计，若是执行到位，能分化北狄和东虞联军，让北狄和东虞回归战前的状态，让大炎不至于伤筋动骨。就这样一个少年，他弄出来的东西能简单吗？他弄出来的东西要是那么简单，那都对不起他好吧！
content_en: The Liu family is in decline, but the Liu family is a scholarly family and was once a famous family in Kyoto.And Mrs. Liu is now the backbone of the Liu family. If Mrs. Liu is asked to kneel down and beg for help, the people of Kyoto can break the backbones of everyone in the Liu family.Even if the Liu family can be saved temporarily, the Liu family is just trying to survive in another way!Of course Mr. Jiang knows this very well, but so what?She didn't want to suffer with the Liu family.She had just returned from the Jiang family, but her father said that Liu Gongjin was the scapegoat chosen by everyone, and even the King of Heaven and I could not save him.If the emperor cannot find out the truth, the most likely possibility is to let Liu Gongjin bear all this, thus saving the Liu family.Therefore, no matter how much money the Liu family spends, they can't save Liu Gongjin. In this case, why not let the old lady jump around by herself, so as to save the Liu family's business and divide the Liu family's business.This is also the reason why she destroyed Tang Yi's letters.It was just Jiang's words that aroused the disgust of most people in the Liu family. Sister-in-law Shen stood up on the spot and angrily said: "What are you talking nonsense? Are all the Liu family dead? Do you need mother to kneel down and beg for mercy?" "If mother really kneels down, the Liu family will be completely hopeless." What Jiang is most dissatisfied with is Shen's awe-inspiring righteousness, and people will be punished for their own sake. Why should she accuse herself from the commanding heights?"Sister-in-law, what you said is wrong. The Liu family is like this now, why are you still pretending to be noble?" "Mr. Liu can beg for help in a low voice, why can't Mom?" Ms. Jiang ignored the angry eyes of everyone in the Liu family, picked her nails and said lightly: "Besides, now only if Mom personally takes action, the eldest brother and Brother Yan can have a chance.Life, otherwise the elder brother and Brother Yan will definitely die." Liu Wenyan's matter was still hidden from the old lady, and now that Jiang was exposing it so plainly, Liu Gongzhi changed his face on the spot: "Jiang Mo, shut up!" "Liu Gongzhi, you are a loser, you dare to attack me?" Liu Gongzhi has always been weak in character, and Jiang has the final say.Seeing that Liu Gongzhi dared to scold her, Mrs. Jiang yelled back angrily on the spot.Just touching Mrs. Liu's cold gaze, her anger was extinguished on the spot. She quickly waved her hands and pretended to laugh: "Oh, mother, the daughter-in-law is talking nonsense. Don't worry, eldest brother will not die, and neither will brother Yan." The old lady ignored Jiang and looked at Shen indifferently: "What's wrong with brother Yan?" Seeing that she couldn't keep it secret, Shen had to tell the truth: "Yan'er did go out with Prince Yuanbo, saying that there was someone who could save the husband, but they went to the brothel that night and were taken away by Jin Yiwei for some reason."There was also Xiao Yi, and Yi'er was also taken away."The Liu family only knew that Liu Wenyan and Tang Yi were taken away by Jin Yiwei that night. They inquired around and said that they had offended Liu Zhou, the son of the Minister of Household Affairs.Shen naturally didn't believe it. Jin Yiwei was directly under the emperor. Even if Liu Zhou's father was the Minister of Household Affairs, there was no way he could alert Jin Yiwei to take action personally.Something else must have happened that night.What Shen didn't know was that it was entirely Liang Shao's fault that the Jin Yiwei took away Liang Shao and Liu Wenyan. Emperor Yanwen imprisoned him on the spot just to teach him a lesson.How dare you tell me what to do with the person I like?When the old lady heard that Tang Yi was also involved, she stood up in shock: "What? Xiaoyi was also involved. How come they were taken away by the Jin Yiwei? Have you ever asked what happened to the Tang family?" Shen's face was gloomy and said: "I asked, Yan ShuangyuA sign was erected in front of the Tang family's house that the Liu family and dogs were strictly prohibited." On the night when Tang Yi and Liu Wenyan were taken to Jinyiwei, she went there in person to ask what was going on with Tang Jing, but the concierge brought out a sign saying that you had to kneel down to enter.Yan Shuangyu is obviously seeking personal revenge!After hearing what Shen said, the old lady looked livid and said coldly: "Send someone to keep an eye on the Tang family to make sure Tang Jing returns home. I'll go there in person and ask him what's going on. I want to see...if he dares to let me kneel into the Tang family!" Shen wanted to say something, but she held back her words. No one could stop the old lady from what she decided to do.Liu Gongzhi glared at Mrs. Jiang fiercely. He knew very well what Mr. Jiang wanted to do.However, he had no way to deal with Jiang....Tang Yi did not follow Yiyi back to Beizhen Fusi. After leaving the minister's house, Xiao Di personally sent Xiao Lan and Kong Shilan back to the princess' house in order to prevent Tang Yi from persecuting his sister, regardless of Xiao Lan's objection.It was still early, so Tang Yi did not go back to Tang Mansion, but went directly to General Mansion.Di Cang was old, and although he still had the desire to serve his country, Emperor Yanwen did not let him lead an army to the north for fear that he would die in the north.After several days of hard work, a training ground that Tang Yi needed has been erected on the campus of the General's Mansion. Next, in addition to going to work, he also needs to go to and from the General's Mansion for training to build up his physical fitness.Otherwise, even if he was the God of Killing in his previous life, now he is nothing more than an ant in front of the martial arts in this world."Boy, is this the training ground you're talking about? I've been studying it with Qin Guogong and Lu Guogong for two days, but they still can't figure out how to do it." Di Cang looked at Tang Yi with his hands folded, a fierce light in his eyes.Tang Yi subconsciously distanced himself from Di Cang. It was obvious that His Majesty did not allow him to lead troops to help the north. This bad old man was in a very unhappy mood, and he was like a powder keg.It's going to explode at one point, and he doesn't want to get beaten!When Di Cang saw Tang Yi trying to hide, he carried him back: "Why are you hiding? Tell us what's going on." He could only find a few old friends these days to deduce the northern battlefield together.After just a few days of deductions, when it came to the combat power of the Beidi army, none of the three had any good strategies to defeat the enemy.No one can convince anyone, so they can only study the training base built by Tang Yirang.After watching it for two days, they still didn't understand how Tang Yi played in this training ground."Old man, this is indeed the training ground I mentioned. Don't pinch me first. I'll teach you how to play." Tang Yi bared his teeth and felt as if his shoulders were about to be crushed.Di Cang grunted and let go of him. He immediately took off his sword and ran towards the training ground.I have to say that Di Cang's engineers are very powerful, and they almost restored his drawings perfectly.There is almost no big difference from the training base of the special forces in the previous life."What do you mean? This kid wants to use this training ground to train his skinny monkey-like body? Are you kidding me?" Qin Guogong Qin Mu looked at Tang Yi's thin body and laughed. Is this guy missing training?This is a lack of food!"Old Di, you spent so much time studying this training ground... Well, maybe it was really created by this kid.
